summary: Move the example with 'lo masxewa' to Infectum-wa
rationale: The head paradigm gives masxele/masxe. In this example masxewa is Infectum masxe plus -wa, rather than the Preterit masxele. The adjacent qoṭaʕwa likewise carries -wa. File this example in an Infectum-wa box in the same stem; retain the following example with lo masxele under Preterit.
